arguments.description: One towering irregular pale-stone mountain peak as a SEPARATE fantasy strategy-game pixel-art landmark. Dramatic fractured vertical cliff faces, split ridges, deep crevices, jutting natural ledges, small flat monastery-support terrace near the summit and sparse moss in cracks. Slim high silhouette with a substantial rocky base, visibly different from a rounded hill. No temple, buildings, bridges, waterfall, mist, text, sky, ground scenery or cast shadow: this is the independent cliff layer for a sacred monastery among multiple peaks. Shallow three-quarter view, upper-left warm light, crisp dark selective outlines and deliberate readable pixel clusters. Controlled pale grey, cool blue-grey and subdued turquoise accent. Transparent background and clear lower ground anchor.
